notes.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness（dsh-acp）输入 / 也弹出命令推荐：该适配器不通过 ACP 上报命令，GrokX 使用其实际内置命令（compact / plan / goal / permission / feedback）兜底，其他 CLI 维持实时上报。本次仅提供 macOS universal 安装包；Windows x64/ARM64 因 GitHub Actions 账户付款限制未能构建。
notes.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh-acp) now offers slash commands too: the adapter reports none over ACP, so GrokX falls back to its actual built-in commands (compact / plan / goal / permission / feedback); other CLIs keep using their live-reported lists. This release ships the macOS universal build only; the Windows x64/ARM64 installers could not be built because GitHub Actions jobs are blocked by the account payment limit.
